claims: April 20th is primarily known as 4/20, the unofficial international counterculture holiday for celebrating and consuming cannabis
April 20th is recognized as UN Chinese Language Day
April 20th is recognized as National Look Alike Day
April 20th is recognized as National Lima Bean Respect Day
The term 4/20 originated in the early 1970s with a group of California high schoolers known as the "Waldos"
UN Chinese Language Day is celebrated to promote cultural exchange
